title: Neutron Holdings: Rapid Growth, Compelling Path To Profitability
text: I am initiating Neutron Holdings with a buy rating, citing strong growth, healthy unit economics, and secular urbanization tailwinds. LIME reported 29% y/y revenue growth to $887M in 2025, with Q1'26 revenue up 32% y/y and 3.8M monthly active users (+21% y/y). Adjusted EBITDA margin reached 24.6% in FY25, with free cash flow of $103.8M and a one-year payback period on fleet investments.

title: Lime Announces Launch of Initial Public Offering
text: SAN FRANCISCO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Neutron Holdings, Inc. (“Lime”), the largest global shared micromobility business, today announced that it has launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering. Lime has filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) to offer 6,956,522 shares of its common stock, 6,679,791 shares of which are being offered by Lime and 276,731 shares of which are being offered by certain existing stockholders,.
